instruction: Explain Newton's first law for 10th grade CBSE physics.
output: Newton's first law states that an object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion with the same speed and in the same direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force. This is also known as the law of inertia in the CBSE curriculum. Example: A book on a table remains at rest until pushed.
